Maratha Reservation Protester Heads to Mumbai Amidst Police Presence

Manoj Jarange Patil has proceeded towards Mumbai to protest for Maratha reservation, defying a ban on his movement. Police have deployed a large force along his route. The Chief Minister stated that 12 out of Patil's 13 demands have been accepted and acted upon. Patil is reportedly traveling alone.
